label: 四合院围墙
description: 输入多个矩形（每个矩形为一张 0/1 网格，或一张每块不同 id 的多值网格），取每个矩形长边方向的中心线，按围绕整体质心的环形顺序，用连接段把各条中心线首尾串成一个闭合的「框」，输出一张围墙网格。坐标约定：x→列、y→行。
description-en: Takes multiple rectangles (each a 0/1 grid, or one multi-value grid with a distinct id per rectangle), draws the center line along each rectangle's long edge, orders them in a ring around the overall centroid, and stitches the center lines head-to-tail with connector segments into one closed frame. Outputs a single wall grid. Coordinates: x→column, y→row.
icon: 深色圆角方块底，内部几个矩形房屋俯视排成一圈，一条浅色闭合折线穿过每个矩形长边中心并把它们串成方框（四合院围墙），扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: rects
inputs.label: 矩形列表
inputs.description: 矩形输入：可接 0/1 网格列表（每张一个矩形），也可接单张多值网格（每个不同非零 id 视为一个矩形）。取每个矩形的最小包围盒求长边中心线。
inputs.description-en: Rectangle input: a list of 0/1 grids (one rectangle each), or a single multi-value grid (each distinct non-zero id is one rectangle). The long-edge center line is derived from each rectangle's bounding box.

inputs.name: thickness
inputs.label: 围墙厚度
inputs.description: 围墙线宽（格数），1 为单格细线，越大墙越厚。
inputs.description-en: Wall line thickness in grid cells; 1 is a single-cell thin line, larger values widen the wall.

outputs.name: wall
outputs.label: 围墙网格
outputs.description: 单张围墙网格：穿过每个矩形长边中心线、并把它们串成闭合框的线段处为 1，其余为 0。
outputs.description-en: Single wall grid: cells on the closed frame (the long-edge center lines plus their connectors) are 1, others are 0.
